segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, the Euler Line is the foundational central line discovered by Leonhard Euler in seventeen sixty-five. In every non-equilateral triangle, the Centroid X two, the Circumcenter X three, the Orthocenter X four, and the Nine-Point Center X five are strictly collinear.

segments.text: Because the medial triangle and reference triangle A B C are homothetic at the Centroid X two with scale factor negative one-half, the orthocenter of the medial triangle is the circumcenter X three of A B C. Consequently, X two lies between X three and X four at exactly one-third the distance from X three to X four.
